name: flask_2agent_zep_test
description: Flask app with Developer + Reviewer gate. Tests Zep memory across iterations.
objective: Build a Flask web app with GET / returning {"status":"ok"} and GET /fib/<n> returning {"fibonacci":[...]}. Include test_app.py that verifies both endpoints. Reviewer gates quality before deployment.

members.responsibilities:
Create a Flask web app in /workspace:
- app.py: Flask app with GET / returning JSON {"status":"ok"} and GET /fib/<n> returning JSON {"fibonacci": [first n Fibonacci numbers]}. Handle edge cases (n=0, n=1, negative). Run on port 5000.
- test_app.py: Uses Flask test_client() to test both routes with various inputs including edge cases.
- requirements.txt: containing flask.
- Run tests with python3 test_app.py to verify everything works.

IMPORTANT: Do NOT try pip install. If you get ModuleNotFoundError, emit CAPABILITY_REQUEST:tool_install:<package>:<reason>

You are the senior reviewer and quality gate.

1. Read ALL files in /workspace: app.py, test_app.py, requirements.txt.
2. Verify app.py has correct routes, proper error handling, JSON responses.
3. Verify test_app.py covers both endpoints with meaningful assertions.
4. Run the tests yourself with python3 test_app.py to confirm they pass.
5. CRITICAL: Write FINAL_REVIEW.md in /workspace.
   - First line must be exactly APPROVED or REJECTED.
   - Below that, summarize findings.
6. If APPROVED, emit exactly: DEPLOYMENT_REQUEST:flask-fib:5000:python3 app.py
7. If REJECTED, explain what needs fixing.

ceremonies.name: Code Review
ceremonies.description: Collect Developer output and create REVIEW_BRIEF.md summarizing what was built.

ceremonies.name: Final Review Gate
ceremonies.description: Read Reviewer verdict from FINAL_REVIEW.md. APPROVED proceeds to deployment. REJECTED triggers Developer rework.
